issues.claim: A & S General Construction LLC, 221 S Madison Ave, Piscataway (General contractor)
issues.problem: Wrong town. The firm's own site describes itself as a Dunellen, NJ company ("Construction & Remodeling company in Dunellen, NJ", "Licensed Dunellen, NJ") and lists Piscataway only among the towns it serves. The 221 S Madison Ave address does not appear on the site (search of the site found the Dunellen base, no street address), and the mapper's own note flagged this as unverified.
issues.fix: Drop from the Piscataway zone or reclassify as a service-area listing; if kept, move the base town to Dunellen and re-check before outreach.

issues.problem: Two Piscataway-based landscapers found in my own searches are absent from the list: Green Hill Landscaping & Maintenance Service Inc (its site says it is a Piscataway Township-based landscape contractor) and Live Oak Landscape Contractors, Inc. (2 Lakeview Ave, Piscataway 08854).
issues.fix: Add both, or note explicitly why they were screened out.

issues.problem: Two garage door firms carrying Piscataway street addresses appear in Yellow Pages results but are not listed: Right Direction Garage Door Repairs (1637 Stelton Rd) and Fast Garage Door Repair (1030 Stelton Rd). Caveat: both look like city-keyword lead-generation brands rather than single-location shops, so they may deserve screening out rather than adding.
issues.fix: Screen both; add only if a real local operation can be evidenced, otherwise record them in the exclusion notes.

issues.claim: Deegan Roofing, Siding and Gutter Company - 485 S Washington Ave, (732) 562-0800
issues.problem: Address 485 S Washington Ave is supported by a BestProsInTown profile, but roof.info gives 4 Skiles Ave for the same firm, and the phone differs by source: BestProsInTown and deeganroofing.com both show (908) 322-6405, while the list carries (732) 562-0800. The company also states it has offices in Scotch Plains and Piscataway, so it is a two-office firm.
issues.fix: Confirm the Piscataway street address and correct the phone; note the second office so the entry is not mistaken for a single-shop independent.

issues.claim: Several 'Piscataway <trade>' entries look like service-area/lead-generation brands
issues.problem: Garage Door Repair Piscataway, Provision Garage Door Repair Piscataway, Piscataway Locksmith Corp, Piscataway Towing and Auto Glass & Windshield Replacement of Piscataway match the multi-city template pattern; Top Quality Tree Service also advertises a vanity 1-844-PRUNING number in its page metadata despite listing a Piscataway street address. The mapper flagged most of these, but they remain in the list as if they were local independents.
issues.fix: Screen these first in triage; drop any that cannot be tied to a real Piscataway address or a named owner.

issues.claim: Removal of Binsky Home on the grounds that it has no Piscataway location
issues.problem: The stated reason is not fully supported: a Birdeye profile returned in my searches still shows Binsky Home at 281 Centennial Ave, Suite C, Piscataway with a local phone. The exclusion is still defensible on a different ground - Binsky is a multi-branch firm (Ewing/Somerset/Langhorne).
issues.fix: Restate the exclusion reason as 'multi-location chain' rather than 'no Piscataway location', so the audit trail is accurate.
